description: This source file defines a RecyclerView.Adapter implementation called TaskCardAdapter for displaying a list of Task entities in a TV-friendly UI. It manages a list of tasks, binds task data to UI components, handles user interactions such as clicks and toggles, and applies focus outlines for TV navigation.

classes.name: TaskCardAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for displaying Task objects in a RecyclerView, supporting item updates and user interactions.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set and refreshes the display.

methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder objects by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder at a specified position.
